title: Trappes Attack: RN Leaflets Found in Suspect's Car
detail: Rassemblement National leaflets were found in the car of the suspect in the Trappes attack, whom relatives describe as 'racist', according to Le Monde.

title: Constitutional Council Rejects RN and UDR Demand for Ferrand's Resignation
detail: The Constitutional Council rejected the demand by the RN and UDR that its president Richard Ferrand resign, according to Le Monde.
